title: Generation3dGeometryRequest
description: Evaluates every widget of a generation3d snapshot to typed geometry. State the snapshot in full, or name the artifact so the gateway binds its document. A run is resumed by handing the previous result back as the previous state.

snapshot.description: A Generation3dSnapshot (s.procedural.generation3d): the flow host snapshot of widgets and synapses, and the generation play state.

document.description: The artifact to evaluate, bound by the gateway from the artifact id; a caller never states these bytes.

generation.description: The id of the generation whose values override the slider, note, image and variable widgets.
